```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
day1 <- read.csv("day1_full.csv") 
day2 <- read.csv("day2_full.csv") 
day3 <- read.csv("day3_full.csv")
```

```{r}
day1 <- day1 |> filter(boatType != "Unknown") |> 
  mutate(boatType = if_else(classId == "voyageur",
                            "Voyageur",
                            boatType)) |>
  mutate(n_paddler = case_when(
    str_detect(classId, "1") ~ 1,
    str_detect(classId, "2") ~ 2,
    str_detect(classId, "3") ~ 3,
    str_detect(classId, "4") ~ 4,
    .default = 1
  ))

day2 <- day2 |> filter(boatType != "Unknown") |>
  mutate(boatType = if_else(classId == "voyageur",
                            "Voyageur",
                            boatType)) |>
  mutate(n_paddler = case_when(
    str_detect(classId, "1") ~ 1,
    str_detect(classId, "2") ~ 2,
    str_detect(classId, "3") ~ 3,
    str_detect(classId, "4") ~ 4,
    .default = 1
  ))

day3 <- day3 |> filter(boatType != "Unknown") |>
  mutate(boatType = if_else(classId == "voyageur",
                            "Voyageur",
                            boatType)) |>
  mutate(n_paddler = case_when(
    str_detect(classId, "1") ~ 1,
    str_detect(classId, "2") ~ 2,
    str_detect(classId, "3") ~ 3,
    str_detect(classId, "4") ~ 4,
    .default = 1
  ))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = (day1 |> filter(boatType == "SUP")), aes(x = value)) +
  geom_density()
```

```{r}
library(shiny)

boat_tabs <- tabsetPanel(
  id = "craft",
  type = "hidden",
  tabPanel("Canoe",
    radioButtons("people_sel", 
                 label = "How many people?",
                 choices = 1:4),
  ),
  tabPanel("Kayak",
    radioButtons("people_sel", 
                 label = "How many people?",
                 choices = c(1, 2)),
  ),
  tabPanel("Voyageur",
           radioButtons("people_sel", 
                 label = "How many people?",
                 choiceNames = "4+", choiceValues = 1)
  ),
  tabPanel("SUP",
           radioButtons("people_sel", 
                 label = "How many people?",
                 choices = c(1))
  ),
)

day_tabs <- tabsetPanel(
  id = "level",
  type = "hidden",
  tabPanel("day1",
    sliderInput("level_sel", 
                 label = "What water level?",
                 min = 1706, max = 1707, value = 1706.5),
  ),
  tabPanel("day2",
    sliderInput("level_sel", 
                 label = "What water level?",
                 min = 2, max = 8, value = 5),
  ),
  tabPanel("day3",
    sliderInput("level_sel", 
                 label = "What water level?",
                 min = 2.5, max = 4.5, value = 3.5),
  )
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      radioButtons("day_sel",
                   label = "Which day are you interested in?",
                   choiceNames = c("Day 1", "Day 2", "Day 3"),
                   choiceValues = c("day1", "day2", "day3")),
      sliderInput("temp_sel",
                  label = "What temperature?",
                  min = 45, max = 80, value = 60),
      day_tabs,
      selectInput("boat_sel",
                   label = "Which type of craft?",
                   choices = c("Canoe", "Kayak", "SUP", "Voyageur")),
      boat_tabs,
      actionButton("action", label = "Generate Prediction")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("dist_plot"),
      textOutput("pred_print")
    ),
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$boat_sel, {
    updateTabsetPanel(inputId = "craft", selected = input$boat_sel)
  })
  observeEvent(input$day_sel, {
    updateTabsetPanel(inputId = "level", selected = input$day_sel)
  })
  
  adk_react <- reactive({
    data <- get(input$day_sel)
  })
  
  pred_react <- reactive({
    mod_time <- lm(value ~ boatType + temp + water, adk_react())
    user_boat <- data.frame(boatType = input$boat_sel, temp = input$temp_sel )
  })

  output$dist_plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(data = adk_react(), aes(x = value)) +
      geom_density()
  })
  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
